title: Chapter 751 Lin Changle; Brother Lin!
content:
Chapter 751 Lin Changle; Brother Lin!

Chapter 751  Lin Changle; Brother Lin!

"Phew!"

At this moment, dark clouds suddenly gathered in the sky, instantly turning the entire Earth into darkness.

"Rumble!"

The terrifying lightning produced a deafening sound and seemed to tear the entire sky into countless ravines. It was ferocious and terrifying.

The wind blew, and the branches swayed.

"Boom!"

In the next moment, the entire world was filled with even more powerful thunderbolts, causing the earth to tremble.

Dazzling lightning illuminated the earth and quickly gathered in the air.

Gradually, it formed a five-clawed golden dragon that bared its fangs and brandished its claws, soaring into the sky.

"Ang!"

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan's mind.

[Ding! Dragon King's soul detected.]

[Dragon King's Soul: The soul of the ancient Dragon King, reincarnated.]

Lin Fan squinted his eyes and said to the system,""After he reincarnates, how will it affect my son?"

[Requires 1 million spirit stones. Do you wish to inquire?]

"Yes, sir!"

[Your son will have extremely high cultivation talent.]

"Will he affect my son's memory and control him?"

[No.]

When Lin Fan heard that, he heaved a sigh of relief.

"Ang!"

At this moment, the golden dragon in the sky roared at the sky, and the entire world shook again.

Then, it rushed down toward the Coiling Dragon Villa and entered Huang Ling's body.

Not long after, the sound of a baby crying could be heard in the Coiling Dragon Villa.

Then, Dai Weixue walked out with a baby in her arms and a smile on her face.

"Xiaofan, look at this nose. It looks so much like yours."

"This skin is too tender."

"Hehe, he's still laughing when you praise him."

Although Dai Weixue had already hugged two grandchildren.

However, she was also very happy to have another one.

"Mom, give me a hug, give me a hug," Lin Xiaoyao said."

"Why are you in such a hurry?" Dai Weixue asked."

"If you're really in a hurry, you should give birth to one quickly."

Lin Xiaoyao was speechless.

In the past, she also yearned for love, marriage, and children.

However, when there was a handsome man like Lin Fan beside her, she was shocked.

She suddenly lost interest in other boys.

How could they get married and have children?

Beside him, Kathleen, whose beautiful eyes seemed to be shining with starlight, couldn't help but say,"Can I hug you?"

"Of course," Dai Weixue smiled."

As he spoke, he handed the baby to Kathleen.

At the same time, he did not forget to say,"Look, how cute is this baby? You're so beautiful. You'll definitely have a cute child in the future."

Dai Weixue was looking at the bowl and thinking about the pot.

Kathleen carefully held the baby, and her beautiful face bloomed like a flower.

After a long time, she reluctantly gave the baby to Lin Fan.

"Lele, smile."

Lele was obviously the child's name.

His full name is Lin Changle.

This was a name that Lin Fan had come up with long ago.

His idea was simple. As long as the child was happy, it was fine.

With Lin Changle in the Coiling Dragon Villa, everyone was filled with joy.

If he was happy, he naturally had to celebrate.

Hence, Lin Fan gave Tai Ba a curse set that day.

That night, Kailin came to Lin Fan's room again.

"I want to have children too."

He worked hard and did not speak for a night.

....

On the other hand, in the Demon Realm.

The black power of the curse around Tai Ba's body suddenly surged, and he could not help but spit out a large mouthful of blood.

"Puff!"

Due to the intense war between the Demon Realm and the Buddha Realm in recent years, as well as the fact that more and more factions and experts coveted the Heart of the Demon Saint King, the Demon Realm suffered heavy casualties and the situation worsened day by day.

Sometimes, Tai Ba wondered if he should continue fighting.

However, as the curse fell, he became extremely deranged again.

"Pu Guo, didn't you want to fight?" he shouted ferociously. Then let's fight to our heart's content!"

Then, Tai Ba's voice spread for a million miles,""From today onwards, I will kill Buddha without mercy!"

A blood-red murderous aura surged wildly, causing the eyes of countless demons to turn red as they bit at the bald man in the distance.

An even more tragic war began!

....

In the dark universe.

Li Hao had always dressed casually, but today, he had changed into a set of very clean and tidy clothes.

Because he had already gotten married yesterday. He had married a beauty from another world.

He drank a big bowl of wine and said cheerfully,"So comfortable!"

Then, he said to Lin Chengzhen,""Cheng Zhen, we've been in the dark universe for hundreds of years, right? I say, why don't you find a woman? Could it be that he wanted to be a bachelor for the rest of his life?"

Lin Chengzhen took a sip of wine and did not answer.

"Brother, you…" Li Hao said again. Don't tell me you like men?"

As she spoke, she couldn't help but put some distance between them.

"Go to hell, you're the one who likes men," Lin Chengzhen said."

"I just want to find a suitable one.""

"Alright, drink it yourself. I'll walk around."

As soon as he finished speaking, he took a step forward and disappeared from where he was.

After a long time, Lin Cheng appeared on a busy street.

He went to a random restaurant and ordered two side dishes and a pot of wine. He drank alone and looked at the crowd outside the window with indifference.

At this moment, a beautiful woman in a long blue dress walked over from afar.

Everywhere he passed, he would look at him and exclaim.

In the next moment, two men hidden in the crowd seemed to have a grudge against the beauty as they attacked her with sharp blades.

This slash was meant to split the beauty in half, causing blood to splatter on the spot.

"Whoosh!"

However, this did not happen.

Because a tall man was blocking the way.

He... It was Lin Cheng Zhen.

With a sweep of his leg, he sent the two men flying, heavily injured and vomiting blood.

The reason why Lin Chengzhen attacked was partly because the woman was beautiful.

On the other hand, he couldn't stand such behavior.

"Are you alright?" Lin Chengzhen turned around and asked."

The current Lin Cheng Zhen was already somewhat similar to Lin Fan.

Even so, he was still very handsome.

The beauty was stunned.

"I'm fine," she said after a while."

"Thank you for saving me just now. Otherwise, I don't know what would have happened.""

How was it?

In fact, she had already noticed the two of them.

Moreover, he did not take it to heart at all.

That was because she had pretty good strength to begin with.

Moreover, she had extremely powerful protective equipment and escape talismans on her. There was no need to worry at all.

"My name is Ke Xin. What's your name, benefactor?""

"My name is Lin Chengzhen. You don't have to call me benefactor. It's just a small matter."Lin Chengzhen said.

"How can that do?" Kexin asked.

"However, benefactor is indeed not very nice to hear. If you don't mind, I'll call you Brother Lin. Is that okay?""
